findings: NEW ALL-TIME ACCURACY RECORD — the coverage lever delivers: best 96.25% at iter 165 (1.58 sensors/step), baseline 93.40% (1.40). Remaining gap to 97%: 0.75pp ~= 1 eval step; residual analytic gaps [2,2,2,1] with oracle bound 100% at tl=3, so the ceiling is now purely policy/decay-side. Peak-then-decay persists (best at iter 165).
